qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Historical ROIC of ~8% falls below the 12% hurdle; thin operating margins (3-4% GAAP) and aggressive OEM buyer power eliminate structural pricing power above inflation.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3b (ROIC ~8% vs 12% hurdle; razor-thin margins of 3-4% and intense OEM buyer power leave Magna with zero structural pricing power).
qualitative.evidence: Magna's multi-year ROIC averages ~8%, persistently trailing its cost of capital and failing the 12% hurdle. Operating margins remain compressed at 3-4% GAAP (5-6% adjusted EBIT). Automotive OEMs possess immense countervailing power and enforce mandatory annual contractual cost downs, requiring Magna to negotiate commercial recoveries rather than exercising genuine independent pricing power.
